designationHistory.indexText: The Oxbow National Wildlife Refuge along the Nashua River in Massachusetts was established by a transfer of federal property for wildlife purposes.

authority.citation: Transfer of federal property for wildlife purposes (16 U.S.C. 667b)

designationHistory.note: FWS gives May 24, 1974. The source of the transferred land (FWS documents elsewhere associate it with Fort Devens) was not verified here.
